author: KobeissiLetter
text:
BREAKING: US diesel prices rise to a fresh record high of $6.49/gallon and have now hit new a record for 12-straight days.

This officially puts diesel prices up +100% from their low seen in January, just 9 months ago.

California continues to face the highest average diesel price, at a record $8.41/gallon, with its average gas price up to $6.14/gallon.

Rate hike expectations for October are also now at new highs.
